channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Karnataka Sets Up 16-Member Gig Workers Welfare Board, Mandates 1–1.5% Fee for Aggregators
item.description: Karnataka launches a statutory board to ensure social security for gig workers, with fees collected from app-based platforms.

item.title: Alert Passengers Escape Just In Time As Bengaluru-Bound Sleeper Bus Catches Fire Near Shivamogga
item.description: All 36 passengers escaped after a sleeper bus caught fire near Hosanagara, though six were injured while fleeing.

item.title: Padma Shri at 90+: How Bhiklya Ladakya Dhinda’s Breath Preserved a Tribal Musical Legacy
item.description: A lifelong Tarpa musician from Palghar is honoured with the Padma Shri for preserving tribal culture against neglect and poverty.

item.title: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar Dies in Baramati Plane Crash During Landing
item.description: Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar and three others died in a charter plane crash in Baramati.

item.title: Massive Avalanche Hits Sonamarg Tourist Resort in J&K; No Casualties Reported
item.description: A late-night avalanche triggered by heavy snowfall struck Sonamarg, disrupting travel but causing no casualties due to timely warnings.

item.title: UP Bar Council Elections in Lucknow Halted After Lawyers Allege Pre-Marked Ballots; Polling Postponed Indefinitely
item.description: Voting in Lucknow’s Bar Council elections was postponed indefinitely after lawyers alleged ballot tampering, sparking protests and forcing officials to halt polling.

item.title: Loved, Feared, Unstoppable: How Ajit Pawar Ruled Maharashtra’s Political Chessboard
item.description: A feature on the 44-year political journey of Ajit Pawar, from Baramati to the Deputy CM's office.

item.title: ‘I Am Calling It Off’: Global Icon Arijit Singh Retires From Playback Singing, Music Journey Continues
item.description: Arijit Singh retired from playback singing to focus on independent music and classical roots.

item.title: Brahmaputra Tragedy: Six Of A Family Missing After Overloaded Boat Capsizes In Assam’s Barpeta
item.description: Six family members, including four children, are missing after an overloaded boat capsized in the Brahmaputra.

item.title: MP: Elderly Woman Dies on Handcart as Husband Struggles to Reach Hospital, Raising Concern Over Emergency Transportation
item.description: An elderly woman’s death while being taken to hospital on a handcart has triggered outrage and an official probe into emergency healthcare failures in Madhya Pradesh.
